creation.title: Create New Task
creation.description: Describe what you want to build. The AI will analyze your request and create a detailed specification.
creation.placeholder: Describe the feature, bug fix, or improvement you want to implement. Be as specific as possible about requirements, constraints, and expected behavior. Type @ to reference files.
creation.descriptionHint: Files and images can be copy/pasted or dragged & dropped into the description.
creation.titlePlaceholder: Leave empty to auto-generate from description
creation.titleHint: A short, descriptive title will be generated automatically if left empty.
creation.classificationHint: These labels help organize and prioritize tasks. They're optional but useful for filtering.
creation.requireReviewHint: When enabled, you'll be prompted to review the spec and implementation plan before the coding phase begins. This allows you to approve, request changes, or provide feedback.
creation.baseBranchHint: Override the branch this task's worktree will be created from. Leave empty to use the project's configured default branch.
